source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 1136 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1136.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 1136 was established by Ordinance No.33241, passed by the Dallas City Council on September 24, 2025. (Ord. 33241)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1136.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 1136 is established on property generally bounded by Bonnie View Road, Southerland Avenue, and Arrow Road, south of the terminus of Dalview Avenue, and on the east line of Arrow Road, north of Southerland Avenue. The size of PD 1136 is approximately 28.192 acres. (Ord. 33241)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1136.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51A apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51A. In this article, STOOP means a small porch leading to the entrance of a residence.

(c) This district is considered to be a residential zoning district. (Ord. 33241)

sections.title: Exhibit
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1136.104. EXHIBIT.

The following exhibit is incorporated into this article:

Exhibit 1136A: conceptual plan. (Ord. 33241)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1136.105. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Development and use of the Property must comply with the conceptual plan (Exhibit 1136A). If there is a conflict between the text of this article and the conceptual plan, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 33241)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1136.106. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) Except as provided in this section, no development plan is required, and the provisions of Section 51A-4.702 regarding submission of or amendments to a development plan, site analysis plan, development schedule, and landscape plan do not apply.

(b) For single family and handicapped group dwelling unit uses, development and use of the Property must comply with a subdivision plat. If there is a conflict between the text of this article and a subdivision plat, the text of this article controls. (Ord. 33241)

sections.title: Main Uses Permitted
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1136.107. MAIN USES PERMITTED.

The only main uses permitted are those main uses permitted in the TH-3(A) Townhouse District, subject to the same conditions applicable in the TH-3(A) Townhouse District, as set out in Chapter 51A. For example, a use permitted in the TH-3(A) Townhouse District only by specific use permit (SUP) is permitted in this district only by SUP; a use subject to development impact review (DIR) in the TH-3(A) Townhouse District is subject to DIR in this district; etc. (Ord. 33241)

sections.title: Accessory Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1136.108. ACCESSORY USES.

As a general rule, an accessory use is permitted in any district in which the main use is permitted. Some specific accessory uses, however, due to their unique nature, are subject to additional regulations in Section 51A-4.217. For more information regarding accessory uses, consult Section 51A-4.217. (Ord. 33241)

sections.title: Yard, Lot, And Space Regulations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1136.109. YARD, LOT, AND SPACE REGULATIONS.

(Note: The yard, lot, and space regulations in this section must be read together with the yard, lot, and space regulations in Division 51A-4.400. If there is a conflict between this section and Division 51A-4.400, this section controls.)

(a) In general. Except as provided in this section, the yard, lot and space regulations for the TH-3(A) Townhouse District apply.

(b) Front yard.

(1) Minimum front yard is 20 feet.

(2) Encroachments such as awnings, balconies, bay windows, ramps, retaining walls, stairs, stoops, and unenclosed porches are allowed to encroach into the required front yard.

(3) Blockface continuity provisions do not apply.

(c) Side and rear yard. Minimum side and rear yard is five feet.

(d) Density. Maximum number of dwelling units is 126.

(e) Lot coverage. Maximum lot coverage is 60 percent. Aboveground parking structures are included in lot coverage calculations; surface parking lots and underground parking structures are not.

(f) Lot size.

(1) Except as provided in this subsection, minimum lot size is 4,000 square feet.

(2) For platted lots within 220 feet of Bonnie View Road, minimum lot size is 6,000 square feet. (Ord. 33241)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking And Loading
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1136.110. OFF-STREET PARKING AND LOADING.

(a) Except as provided in this section, consult the use regulations in Division 51A- 4.200 for the specific off-street parking and loading requirements for each use.

(b) A minimum of 0.25 guest parking spaces per dwelling unit must be provided.

(c) Guest parking must be provided in the locations shown on the conceptual plan. (Ord. 33241)

sections.title: Environmental Performance Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1136.111. ENVIRONMENTAL PERFORMANCE STANDARDS.

See Article VI. (Ord. 33241)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1136.112. LANDSCAPING.

(a) Landscaping must be provided in accordance with Article X.

(b) Plant materials must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition. (Ord. 33241)

sections.title: Design Standards For Residential Uses
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1136.113. DESIGN STANDARDS FOR RESIDENTIAL USES.

(a) Driveway spacing. Driveways that access front entry garages must be located a minimum of 12 feet away from adjacent driveways.

(b) Open space. A minimum of eight acres must be reserved as open space and a linear park, as shown on the conceptual plan.

(c) Sidewalks.

(1) Sidewalks with a minimum width of six feet must be provided along public or private streets.

(2) Sidewalks must be level with driveway crossings, remain clear of obstacles at all times, and be constructed to meet all city and American with Disabilities Act (ADA) specifications.

(d) Pedestrian trail. A pedestrian trail of at least 1,100 linear feet and a minimum width of five feet must be provided within the open space and linear park areas shown on the conceptual plan.

(e) Pedestrian-scale lighting. Pedestrian-scale lighting that provides a minimum maintained average illumination level of 1.5 footcandles must be provided along public sidewalks and adjacent to public streets. The design and placement of both the standards and fixtures must be approved by the director of transportation.

(f) Screening.

(1) A landscape buffer and a screening wall with a minimum height of eight feet above grade that is constructed of brick, stone, or cementitious fiber-board materials must be provided and maintained between a residential use and an adjacent industrial use so that the average sound levels, as measured on the side of the wall facing the residential lot, at a residential use do not exceed, on average, 56 dB(a).

(2) A fence constructed of wood or cementitious fiber-board materials measuring six feet above grade is required on lots abutting Southerland Avenue to act as a screening buffer.

(3) A buffer must be maintained between the adjacent industrial use and residential uses, including trees, vegetation, berms, and other landscaping designed to mitigate sound levels. (Ord. 33241)

sections.title: Street Standards
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1136.114. STREET STANDARDS.

(a) Internal streets must be built to the L-2-U(A) standard in the City of Dallas Street Design Manual. Alleys are not required.

(b) Vehicular access to Bonnie View Road and Southerland Avenue is prohibited from driveways on single-family lots. (Ord. 33241)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1136.115. SIGNS.

Signs must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts in Article VII. (Ord. 33241)

sections.title: Additional Provisions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1136.116. ADDITIONAL PROVISIONS.

(a) The Property must be properly maintained in a state of good repair and neat appearance.

(b) Development and use of the Property must comply with all federal and state laws and regulations, and with all ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city.

(c) A homeowner’s association must be created for the maintenance of all common areas and open space.

(d) No single family structure spacing is required. (Ord. 33241)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-1136.117. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

(a) All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the city.

(b) The building official shall not issue a building permit to authorize work, or a certificate of occupancy to authorize the operation of a use, until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. 33241)
